scope: Static review and fully temporary synthetic92-cell tests of final aggregation and second-stage evidence-pack preparation. No real final scores or complete92-cell scientific results were evaluated.

verified_aggregation_rules.planned_grid: 23 unique questions times4 methods equals92 rows. Q01/Q07/Q13 reuse the same question-method answer and score in both main and supplemental groups.
verified_aggregation_rules.Q19_Q20: Q19 andQ20 are both in the main content denominator. Q19 has no raw-source gold and is excluded only from raw-source coverage; Q20 remains scorable there.
verified_aggregation_rules.weighting: Within each question, criterion scores0/.5/1 are averaged equally; question means are then averaged equally. Different criterion counts do not weight questions differently.
verified_aggregation_rules.failed_answers: Every failed final answer must have zero content score and remains in the planned denominator. Earlier successful subcall exposure can remain nonempty without turning failure into an answer success.
verified_aggregation_rules.completed_only: The completed-only field is a separately named selected-subset diagnostic. The frozen rubric answer_reuse rule explicitly permits it. Primary content and paired comparisons still use all planned questions, including failures.
verified_aggregation_rules.provider_and_budget: Known provider input/output and unknown possible-dispatch counts remain separate from common-input reservations. The retained non-dispatch reservation stays in reservation/input totals and its own count; no provider usage is inferred.
verified_aggregation_rules.overlap_costs: Cohort costs are non-additive because main/supplement overlap. A unique92-cell total must be computed once from unique rows or the corresponding phase ledger.
verified_aggregation_rules.bootstrap: Differences are paired by identical question and method; fixed-seed10000-resample intervals describe variation across this chosen small question set. They do not estimate repeat-service randomness or industry-wide accuracy.

checks: 92 rows,16 method/cohort aggregates and12 paired summaries.
Independent rational-arithmetic checks of question-weighted means.
Three synthetic failed routed answers retained at0; positive failed-answer scores rejected.
Completed-only diagnostic matches the completed subset and leaves primary means unchanged.
Identical overlaps reuse the same scores; synthetic main-plus-supplement cost totals intentionally exceed the unique total.
Known provider/common reservation totals and an initial non-dispatch reservation remain distinct.
Paired means and win/tie/loss counts independently recomputed; bootstrap is deterministic and intervals bounded.

tests.type: Evidence-pack preparation on temporary synthetic92 rows
checks: Valid complete review emits92 temporary cases plus a manifest.
Empty review, stale pack SHA, missing row, boolean score and wrong answer SHA each stop before any material output.
Both scripts reject a changed answer string with stale per-answer SHA even when the whole-pack SHA was updated consistently.
Network and credential-file reads explicitly denied by the test process.
Only temporary fixtures, temporary grading packs and this review document were written.
Aggregation imports the pure source-coverage function; neither reviewed script starts a worker, model client or index workflow.

resolved_findings.original_issue: An existing review filename alone previously permitted evidence exposure, including incomplete or stale grading.
resolved_findings.resolution: Before material output, the gate now verifies rubric and pack SHA, exact unique row coverage, per-answer text hashes, matching question/status/hash, exact criteria and allowed numeric scores/means, and failed=0.

resolved_findings.original_issue: A whole-pack hash alone did not establish that the scored answer text matched its retained per-answer hash and execution identity.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both scripts recompute answer-text SHA; aggregation additionally binds each complete pack row to its content review and the exported execution answer hash.

resolved_findings.original_issue: Python boolean equality could satisfy membership in{0,.5,1}.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both score validators explicitly require int/float types and reject bool.

resolved_findings.original_issue: Cross-subcall ordering, unequal context/call counts and decoder failures required more precise interpretation.
resolved_findings.resolution: The result interpretation now separates exposure-order MRR from earlier retrieval MRR, fixed-policy comparisons from equal-cost causal isolation, incremental cached latency from production speed, and decoder outcomes from claims about remote text or algorithm defects.

required_interpretation_and_final_checks: This review validates code paths and arithmetic using synthetic results, not the real final92 answers, real content grades, final metrics or conclusions. Those still require a separate completed-result audit.

Raw-source coverage is the union of source ranges included in traceableHTTP200 generation requests across the actual chain. It is not the old independent-retrieval result, a complete record of unknown dispatches, or answer accuracy; graph report text is not counted as raw source.

DRIFT/Global may consume different numbers of generations and total context than one-shot baselines. Equal ceilings do not create equal realized budgets or isolate the causal effect of graph reasoning.
The ordered source reciprocal-position diagnostic reflects first exposure across subcalls, not a single retriever ranking. It should not be presented as directly comparable to earlier MRR.
Completed-only scores condition on successful completion and must remain secondary; model/service/adapter failures stay at0 in the primary planned-question score.

The responses_empty_or_multiple_messages category can reflect the service/decoder boundary. Without retained rawSSE, it does not establish exactly what the remote model produced. Do not silently repair or regenerate these completed-attempt outcomes for grading.

Generation token summaries are not total dollar spend; unknown usage, shared embedding reuse, carried graph-build costs and overlapping cohorts require separate accounting. Never add main and supplemental group totals.

Elapsed values describe this execution and its caching arrangement. Check interrupted-duration flags before claiming complete wall time, and do not infer production speed from this unequal-cache setup.
Evidence grading is separate from content grading; gold-anchor overlap is navigation only. The full graph used to verify provenance is not automatically material supplied to the answer model.
Method labels are masked, but prompt structures and content may identify methods. This is AI review, not a human blind evaluation.
